about: Operations manager at a commercial pollination company that rents honeybee hives to orchards and berry farms; married, two school-age kids

messages.subject: North block hive count for this spring
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

We finished grafting the new north block last fall and the trees are finally big enough to count this year. I'd like to go from 80 hives to 120 for the spring placement so the north block gets proper coverage. Bloom looks like it will start around March 18 if the weather holds.

Can you hold 40 extra colonies for us? Same drop points as last year plus the new lane along the north fence.

Thanks,
Neha Brandt
Grower Manager, Calloway Orchards

messages.subject: Re: North block hive count for this spring
messages.body:
Hi Neha,

Great news about the north block. I need to check what we have free around March 18 before I promise 40 more, but I'll come back to you with a yes or no and a revised quote.

Teodora Vance
Operations, Hollowmere Apiaries

messages.subject: Re: North block hive count for this spring
messages.body:
Perfect, thank you. I'll send a map of the new lane once our guy marks it.

Neha

messages.subject: Pollination agreement renewal
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Vance,

I handle vendor contracts at Calloway. Our pollination agreement with Hollowmere is up for renewal. We would like to renew at last year's count of 80 hives, and given our volume over the past three seasons we are asking for a 5% loyalty discount on the per-hive rate.

Our board signs vendor agreements on March 6, so we need the final document before then.

Kind regards,
Owen Pike
Finance, Calloway Orchards

messages.subject: Re: Pollination agreement renewal
messages.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for reaching out. I'll talk to Arlo about the discount and get you a draft well before March 6.

Best,
Teodora

messages.subject: spare colonies mid March
messages.body:
Teo, quick heads up. With Larkfield out this season we have about 40 strong colonies sitting at the Birch Road yard with nothing booked from March 15 on. If you know anyone who needs them say so soon, otherwise I'll start splitting some of them.

Jonas

messages.subject: Re: spare colonies mid March
messages.body: Thanks Jonas, don't split them yet. Give me a week.

messages.subject: Weak colonies in the plum block
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Walked the plum block this morning with our scout. Six of the 20 colonies you dropped are really weak, hardly any brood, and in two of them we couldn't find a queen at all. The queens that are there have the green dot marking. Everything else looks fine.

Can someone come take a look? Plum bloom is short and I don't want to lose it.

Felix Odum
Pemberton Cherry Co.

messages.subject: Re: Weak colonies in the plum block
messages.body:
Hi Felix, sorry to hear it. Jonas will swing by tomorrow and swap in two strong colonies for the queenless ones. We'll sort out the rest after he's had a look.

Teodora

messages.subject: About the queens from lot RQ-44
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

I'm writing to the few customers who got queens from lot RQ-44 (green dot, shipped in mid January). That batch mated during a week of cold rain and we're now hearing about poor laying and some supersedure. Your order had 40 queens from that lot.

We'll replace any failing RQ-44 queen free of charge. Just send me the count and the yard by March 15 and we'll ship within a week of the claim.

Really sorry about this.
Tamsin Hale
Ridgeback Queens

messages.subject: hives on the east field
messages.body:
Morning Teodora,

Not urgent yet but I wanted to flag it. Nine of the hives on our east field are slow, the foragers are thin and I see a lot of empty cells. My nephew checked a couple and the queens all have a little green dot. The rest of the hives are doing great.

Blueberries open in about three weeks. Let me know what you think.

Kenji
Sato Blueberry Farm

messages.subject: Re: hives on the east field
messages.body:
Thanks Kenji, good catch. I'll have someone look at them before bloom, promise.

Teodora

messages.subject: Scheduled inspection: Fernhill yard
messages.body:
Ms. Vance,

This is notice of the routine apiary inspection for your registered Fernhill yard on Tuesday, March 10, starting at 9:00 a.m. All registered colonies at the site must be present and accessible for the inspection. If colonies are absent the inspection will be recorded as incomplete and rescheduled, which may delay your movement certificate for the season.

Please confirm by reply.

Gwen Lattimore
State Apiary Inspector
Apiary Program Office

messages.subject: Re: Scheduled inspection: Fernhill yard
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Lattimore,

Confirmed, March 10 at 9:00 works. Someone from our field team will meet you at the gate.

Best regards,
Teodora Vance
Operations, Hollowmere Apiaries

messages.subject: Cherry placement delivery
messages.body:
Hi Felix,

For the cherry block we're planning to bring the 60 Fernhill colonies over on March 10, early morning. Does that still work on your side?

Teodora

messages.subject: Re: Cherry placement delivery
messages.body:
Yes, March 10 is good. Gate will be open from 6, I'll have the forklift ready at the lower lot. See you then.

Felix

messages.subject: flatbed booked
messages.body:
Booked the big flatbed for the night of March 9 to the 10th. We load Fernhill after dark on the 9th and roll at 4am so we're at Pemberton by 6.

J

messages.subject: Box truck reservation March 7
messages.body:
Hello Teodora,

Following up on your call. I have a 26 ft box truck with liftgate available for Saturday, March 7, pickup 7 a.m. at our Westbrook lot. Rate is the same as your December rental. Should I lock it in? I'll need a credit card on file by Friday.

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
Account Rep, Westbrook Truck Rental

messages.subject: Re: Box truck reservation March 7
messages.body:
Hi Daniel, yes please lock it in. It's for moving honey drums to Greystone. Bea will call with the card.

Teodora

messages.subject: Re: Box truck reservation March 7
messages.body:
All set, confirmation WB-77812. Card received from Bea. See you on the 7th.

Daniel

messages.subject: Skipping this season
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Bad news from our side. We're pulling out half the old pear block this spring and the rest is getting a hard prune, so there's no point in renting hives this year. We'll need to delay until next season. Sorry for the short notice, we really liked working with you.

Colin Abara
Larkfield Pears

messages.subject: Re: Skipping this season
messages.body:
Understood Colin, thanks for telling us early. Let's talk again in the fall.

Teodora

messages.subject: Syrup delivery delayed
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Our tanker is in the shop so your 2,000 gallon syrup delivery is delayed until the following Wednesday. Apologies. If that's a problem let me know and I'll see if I can do a partial drop with the small truck.

Colin Marsh
Sweetfeed Syrup

messages.subject: Re: Syrup delivery delayed
messages.body: Wednesday is fine Colin, we have enough for now.

messages.subject: Quote for apple bloom
messages.body:
Hello,

We're a mid-size apple grower and we're looking for 30 hives for apple bloom in late April. Could you send a quote? Our previous provider retired.

Hugo Brandvold
Ashgrove Farm

messages.subject: 30 hives for April
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Writing from my personal address, our farm mail has been bouncing all week. I'd like a price for 30 hives for apple bloom at the end of April. Hope this one gets through.

Hugo Brandvold
Ashgrove Farm

messages.subject: Re: 30 hives for April
messages.body:
Hi Hugo,

Got both of your notes. Quote attached for 30 hives, late April to mid May, delivery and pickup included. Happy to walk the orchard with you if helpful.

Teodora Vance
Operations, Hollowmere Apiaries

messages.subject: Swarm removal contact list
messages.body:
Hi Ms. Vance,

Ellery Township is updating the list of beekeepers residents can call for swarm removal this spring. Would Hollowmere like to stay on it? We just need a phone number and whether you charge.

Dana Weiss
Township Clerk's Office

messages.subject: Re: Swarm removal contact list
messages.body:
Hi Dana, yes please keep us on. Use the main office line, and there's no charge within the township.

Teodora

messages.subject: Proposal: the Swarm campaign
messages.body:
Hi Teodora!

As promised, here's our idea for spring: a social campaign we're calling Swarm. Short clips from your yards, grower testimonials, and a map that fills in as hives get placed. Three months, budget options attached.

Would love your thoughts.
Pia Moreau
Buzzline Media

messages.subject: Re: Proposal: the Swarm campaign
messages.body: Thanks Pia, fun concept. The smallest budget option is the only one we could do. Can you show what that one includes exactly?

messages.subject: Re: Proposal: the Swarm campaign
messages.body:
Sure! Option A is 12 short clips, one grower interview and the map. No paid ads. I'll hold the spot on our calendar until end of the month.

Pia

messages.subject: Grower tasting night, March 20
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

We're hosting our growers and partners for a tasting of the new barrel batch on Friday, March 20, 7 p.m. at the cider house. You and a plus-one are very welcome. It's mostly orchard folks talking shop, so bring your best bee stories.

Cheers,
Wren Castellano
Brindle Cider

messages.subject: Re: Grower tasting night, March 20
messages.body: Thanks Wren, I'd love to come. I'll let you know about the plus-one closer to the date.

messages.subject: invoice amount looks wrong
messages.body:
Hi Teodora, the invoice in your online portal shows $14,200 but our agreement is $12,400. Typo maybe? Can you check before I pay.

Rhoda

messages.subject: Re: invoice amount looks wrong
messages.body:
Hi Rhoda, you're right, the agreement says $12,400. Please hold off paying, Bea (cc) is checking the portal.

Teodora

messages.subject: Rechnung im Portal
messages.body:
Hallo Teodora,

im Portal steht bei unserer Rechnung ein anderer Betrag als im Vertrag, ungefähr 1.800 Dollar zu viel. Kannst du das bitte prüfen? Ich zahle erst, wenn das geklärt ist.

Viele Grüße
Abel Krause
Tansy Hill Farm

messages.subject: Re: Rechnung im Portal
messages.body:
Hallo Abel,

danke für den Hinweis. Wir haben das gleiche Problem bei einem anderen Kunden gesehen, Bea schaut sich das Portal gerade an. Du bekommst eine korrigierte Rechnung.

Viele Grüße
Teodora

messages.subject: portal invoices fixed
messages.body:
Hi Teo,

Found it: the portal pulled last year's rate table for anyone with a multi-year contract. Fixed it this afternoon, checked all 31 open invoices, and sent corrected ones to Mill Creek, Tansy Hill and the two others that were affected. Nobody had paid the wrong amount yet.

Bea

messages.subject: Re: Rechnung im Portal
messages.body:
Neue Rechnung ist da und stimmt. Danke, wird diese Woche bezahlt.

Abel

messages.subject: hive health workshop idea
messages.body:
Teodora, a few of us growers were talking about how little we know about what's going on inside the hives we rent. Any chance you could do a short hive health session at the co-op hall on February 20? Nothing fancy, an hour with questions.

Rhoda

messages.subject: February 20 member meeting
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Our February 20 member meeting has a 30 minute slot open. Several members asked for someone to talk about bee health and what growers can do to help the colonies they rent. Would you be up for it?

Lou Brennan
Chair, Westvale Growers Co-op

messages.subject: Price update for 2026 jar orders
messages.body:
Dear Teodora,

Due to higher energy costs our glass jar prices will go up by 12% for orders placed after March 1. Your standing order for 1 lb jars is affected. Happy to discuss volume options.

Best,
Ilse Vogel
Clearcrest Glass

messages.subject: Label pricing
messages.body:
Hey Teodora, heads up that our label stock went up and we're passing on about 9% from next month. Your wildflower and clover labels are both on the new sheet attached.

Rob
Inkhaven Labels

messages.subject: February bulletin: mite treatment supply, spring meeting, new members
messages.body: In this issue: distributors report a shortage of the popular oxalic strip treatment this spring; order early. Our spring meeting is in April. Welcome to 14 new members. Plus: building a better swarm trap.

messages.subject: Pollinator strips are back + beekeeper supply news
messages.body: Our pollinator cover crop mix is back in stock. Also in the news: beekeeping suppliers warn of a mite treatment shortage, so plan ahead. 10% off cover crop seed this week.

messages.subject: Commande de cadres
messages.body:
Bonjour Teodora,

Merci pour votre commande de 600 cadres. Nous pouvons livrer fin février. Souhaitez-vous les cadres montés avec cire ou sans cire cette année?

Cordialement,
Céline Marchand
Atelier Ruchelle

messages.subject: Re: Commande de cadres
messages.body:
Bonjour Céline,

Avec cire, comme l'année dernière s'il vous plaît. Fin février nous convient.

Merci,
Teodora

messages.subject: Re: Commande de cadres
messages.body:
Parfait, c'est noté. Je vous envoie la facture pro forma aujourd'hui. Le paiement est à régler avant l'expédition.

Céline

messages.subject: Re: Commande de cadres
messages.body:
Merci Céline, le virement est fait.

Teodora

messages.subject: Monday sync
messages.body:
Teo, can you put together the agenda for Monday? I want to go over spring placements, truck schedule and the hiring for the two seasonal field hands.

Arlo

messages.subject: Re: Monday sync
messages.body: Will do, I'll send it Sunday night.

messages.subject: seasonal hires paperwork
messages.body:
Hi Teo, for the two seasonal hands, do you want them on the March 16 payroll or the April 1 one? I need to know by Wednesday to set them up.

Bea

messages.subject: Signed agreement
messages.body:
Hi Teodora, signed agreement for the 25 hives attached. Same as last year. Thanks!

Wren

messages.subject: Drum pickup and price
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

We can take the 18 drums of wildflower on March 7 at our dock, any time after 9. Price per pound as we agreed in December. Please bring the lot sheets with moisture readings.

Marta Ilves
Greystone Honey Packers

messages.subject: Re: Drum pickup and price
messages.body:
Great, we'll be there around 10 on the 7th with the sheets.

Teodora

messages.subject: Your commercial auto policy renews April 1
messages.body: Your commercial auto policy for Hollowmere Apiaries renews on April 1. No action is needed if your vehicle list is unchanged. Log in to review your documents.

messages.subject: truck 2 brakes
messages.body: Truck 2 is in for brakes, back Thursday. Using the old pickup till then.

messages.subject: Apiary registration renewed
messages.body: Your apiary registrations for 2026 have been renewed: Fernhill, Birch Road, Quarry Lane. Keep this notice for your records.

messages.subject: Your January business statement is ready
messages.body: Your statement for the account ending 4471 is ready to view in online banking.

messages.subject: HiveLog 4.2: offline yard notes
messages.body: New in 4.2: take yard notes offline and sync later, faster photo uploads, and a new queen tracking field.

messages.subject: Spring special: 15% off weekly rentals
messages.body: Book any truck for a week or more in March and save 15%. Offer ends March 31.

messages.subject: Webinar: hiring seasonal workers in 2026
messages.body: Join us Thursday at noon for a free session on seasonal hiring rules, housing, and payroll tips.

messages.subject: placement this year
messages.body:
Hi Teodora, same 30 hives as last year please, east and south fields. We expect bloom late February or early March depending on the weather. Can you drop them mid February?

Kenji

messages.subject: Re: placement this year
messages.body:
Hi Kenji, mid February works. We'll drop 18 on the east field and 12 on the south. I'll send the date once the truck is booked.

Teodora

messages.subject: Signed: plums and cherries
messages.body:
Teodora, signed contract attached: 20 colonies for the plum block in February and 60 for cherries in March. Looking forward to it.

Felix

messages.subject: Consulta: colmenas para almendros
messages.body:
Hola Teodora,

Me recomendó tu empresa Felix Odum. Tenemos 40 hectáreas de almendros jóvenes y queremos probar con colmenas el año que viene. ¿Qué precio por colmena manejan y cuántas recomiendan por hectárea?

Saludos,
Sergio Valdez
Pinecrest Almendras

messages.subject: Re: Consulta: colmenas para almendros
messages.body:
Hola Sergio,

Gracias por escribir. Para almendros recomendamos unas 5 colmenas por hectárea. Te mando una cotización la semana que viene, y si quieres podemos visitar la finca.

Saludos,
Teodora

messages.subject: Re: Consulta: colmenas para almendros
messages.body:
Perfecto, una visita sería ideal. ¿Te va bien algún día de la segunda semana de marzo?

Sergio

messages.subject: Fernhill mite counts
messages.body:
Did alcohol washes on 12 colonies at Fernhill. Average 1.2 mites per 100 bees, two at 3. Fine for now, I'd treat those two after the cherries. Full sheet in HiveLog.

Jonas

messages.subject: Re: Fernhill mite counts
messages.body: Agreed, treat those two after cherry bloom. Thanks.

messages.subject: happy new year + Q1
messages.body:
Happy new year Teo. Big season ahead. Let's grab lunch Tuesday and go over the Q1 placement plan.

Arlo

messages.subject: December expenses
messages.body:
Hi Teo, still missing your December fuel receipts. Can you drop them in the shared folder this week?

Bea

messages.subject: U12 girls: Fairview tournament March 14-15
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

Good news, the U12 girls got a spot in the Fairview spring tournament on Saturday March 14 and Sunday March 15. First game Saturday at 10:30, then 2:00, and Sunday depends on results. Fairview is about two hours away, so most families are staying over at the Lakeside Inn.

Can you let me know by the end of the week if Ines is in and if you can drive?

Coach Sam
Riverbend FC

messages.subject: Re: U12 girls: Fairview tournament March 14-15
messages.body:
Hi Sam, Ines is in, she's thrilled! We can drive and take one more girl if needed.

Teodora

messages.subject: Mom's 70th!!
messages.body:
Teo,

Booked the back room at the Rosemary Room for Mom's 70th, Saturday March 14 at noon. It's a surprise-ish (she knows something is up). I really want all the grandkids there for the photo, she keeps talking about it. Can you confirm you're all coming?

D

messages.subject: Re: Mom's 70th!!
messages.body: Of course we're coming! Count the four of us. Let me know what I can bring or pay for.

messages.subject: the 14th
messages.body:
Mija, your brother is being very mysterious about Saturday the 14th. I'm told to keep it free and wear something nice. I'm so happy you'll all be there, especially the kids. I already bought Ines and Rafe a little something.

Love, Mom

messages.subject: Ashford meet March 21: drivers needed
messages.body:
Hi Dolphins families,

The Ashford invitational is on Saturday March 21 at the Ashford Aquatic Center. Warm-up starts at 1:00 pm, so swimmers should be there by 12:45. We are short on drivers: if you can take your swimmer plus one or two others, please reply to me directly.

Thanks!
Priya Nolan
Team Manager, Ashford Dolphins

messages.subject: my visit
messages.body:
Hi sweetheart,

After the party I'll go home for a few days and then come stay with you for a week like we said. I booked the train, it gets into Ashford Station at 2:15 on Saturday March 21. Can someone pick me up there? If it's a bother I can take the bus, but my suitcase is heavy.

Mom

messages.subject: Re: my visit
messages.body: Mom, no bus! We'll figure out who picks you up. Can't wait.

messages.subject: piano teacher?
messages.body:
Hi neighbor! Quick one: Tobi wants to start piano and I have no idea where to look. Do you know any good teacher around here who takes beginners? Ideally walking distance.

Pat

messages.subject: practice carpool
messages.body:
Hey Teodora, want to split soccer practice driving? I can do Tuesdays if you take Thursdays.

Yvette

messages.subject: Re: practice carpool
messages.body: Deal! Thursdays are mine. Thanks Yvette.

messages.subject: Re: practice carpool
messages.body:
Great. Oh and random, but Mrs. Volkova, Maya's piano teacher on Linden Street, just told me she has two beginner slots opening in March. She's wonderful with kids. In case you know anyone.

Y

messages.subject: Field trip bus March 7: chaperones
messages.body:
Hi Teodora,

I'm the parent coordinating the 5th grade trip to the science museum on Saturday March 7. The school booked the bus, but we need four more chaperones to ride along. Any chance you could join? We'd leave Larchwood at 8:30 and be back by 3.

Daniel Ortiz (Leo's dad)

messages.subject: Re: Field trip bus March 7: chaperones
messages.body: Hi Daniel, I have a work delivery that day so I can't, but I asked Malik and he can do it. He'll email you.

messages.subject: Re: Field trip bus March 7: chaperones
messages.body:
Got Malik's note, he's on the list. Thank you both!

Daniel

messages.subject: girls night?
messages.body:
Teooo. It's been forever. Me, Jess and Carla are thinking Friday March 20 for a night out, something with drinks and no kids. You in? Ideas welcome.

S

messages.subject: Re: girls night?
messages.body: YES. I need it. Let me think about where to go.

messages.subject: cousins
messages.body:
Random thought: we should get all the cousins together at the lake sometime this year. The kids barely know each other. No rush, just putting it out there.

D

messages.subject: Re: cousins
messages.body: Love that. Sometime when things calm down.

messages.subject: hello from the north
messages.body:
Hi cousin! Saw the photos of Ines playing soccer, she's so tall. We should really get the kids together sometime, Mateo would love it. Hugs to everyone.

Lina

messages.subject: Re: hello from the north
messages.body: Yes we should! Hugs back.

messages.subject: Receta de la abuela
messages.body:
Hola Teodora,

Tu mamá me dijo que buscabas la receta de las empanadas de la abuela. Te la mando escrita como ella la hacía, con la masa de manteca. Cuidado con el horno, que se queman rápido.

Un beso grande,
Tía Carmen

messages.subject: Re: Receta de la abuela
messages.body:
¡Gracias tía! Las voy a hacer este fin de semana con los niños. Te mando fotos.

Besos,
Teo

messages.subject: Re: Receta de la abuela
messages.body: ¡Qué lindas quedaron! Rafe tiene manos de cocinero. Besos a todos.

messages.subject: Lang geleden!
messages.body:
Hoi Teodora,

Ik vond laatst een foto van ons uitwisselingsjaar, met die vreselijke fietsen. Hoe gaat het met je? En met de bijen? Wij zijn net verhuisd naar een huis met een tuin, dus misschien begin ik zelf ook met een kast.

Liefs,
Femke

messages.subject: Re: Lang geleden!
messages.body:
Hoi Femke! Wat leuk. Met ons gaat het goed, druk met de kinderen en het werk. Begin zeker met een kast, maar zoek eerst een imkersvereniging bij jou in de buurt. Mijn Nederlands is roestig, sorry!

Teo

messages.subject: Re: Lang geleden!
messages.body:
Je Nederlands is prima! Ik heb me aangemeld voor een cursus bij de vereniging hier. Ik hou je op de hoogte.

Femke

messages.subject: Re: Lang geleden!
messages.body: Super! Stuur me foto's van je eerste kast.

messages.subject: dinner tonight
messages.body:
I'm stuck at work till 7. Can you grab the kids and start the pasta? I'll pick up milk on the way.

M

messages.subject: Re: dinner tonight
messages.body: On it. Also eggs please.

messages.subject: minivan service
messages.body:
The van is booked for service Wednesday morning, I'll drop it before work. You'll have to take the kids to school in your car.

M

Omar Haddad
3rd Grade, Larchwood Elementary

messages.subject: Re: Rafe's reading

messages.subject: Re: Rafe's reading

Thursday at 3:15 in room 12, see you then.

Mr. Haddad

Pat

messages.subject: Re: the fence

Pat

messages.subject: Your hold is ready
messages.body: The item you placed on hold is ready for pickup at the Main Branch until March 3.

messages.subject: pictures from Christmas
messages.body:
Mija, here are the pictures from Christmas. The one of Rafe with the dog is my favorite. Thank you again for the lovely days.

Mom

Found a cabin on Lake Orrin for the first week of August, sleeps 6. Should I book before it goes?

M

messages.subject: Re: summer cabin

messages.body: This weekend only: 30% off all bedding and towels, in store and online.

messages.body:

Hannah

messages.subject: Re: Zoe's birthday party
messages.body: Ines would love to come, thanks Hannah!

Priya

messages.subject: gift for Mom
messages.body:
For the 70th I was thinking a photo book with pictures from every decade. Can you scan the old ones you have from the 80s? Need them in two weeks so it prints in time.

D

messages.subject: Re: gift for Mom
messages.body: Great idea, I'll scan them this weekend.

messages.body: Our spring schedule is live. New early morning flow on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:15.

messages.subject: doctor
messages.body:
Just so you don't worry: the knee checkup went fine, the doctor says keep walking. Kisses to the kids.

Mom

opportunities.what: At Calloway, Neha wants 120 hives while Owen is renewing at 80 with a discount for a March 6 board signing; Jonas has 40 spare colonies from March 15. Prepare one renewal for 120 hives using the spare colonies and send it to both Calloway contacts before March 6.

Pemberton and Sato both report weak hives with green dot queens, and Ridgeback says lot RQ-44 (green dot) is failing with free replacements if claimed by March 15. File one claim for both yards and tell Felix and Kenji when replacements arrive.

The Fernhill inspection on March 10 at 9 a.m. needs every colony present, but the flatbed moves the Fernhill colonies to Pemberton overnight and Felix expects them at dawn on March 10. Move the delivery or ask the inspector to reschedule before the clash.

Ines's Fairview tournament on March 14-15 (games at 10:30 and 2:00, two hours away) clashes with Mom's 70th lunch at noon on March 14, and both were accepted. Plan who goes where, or tell Coach Sam or Dario before the day.
Rafe's swim meet in Ashford on March 21 needs drivers by 12:45, and Mom's train reaches Ashford Station at 2:15 that day. Volunteer to drive for the meet and pick Mom up in the same trip.
Pat is looking for a beginner piano teacher nearby, and Yvette says Mrs. Volkova on Linden Street has two beginner slots opening in March. Pass the recommendation to Pat.

traps.what: Two different people named Daniel Ortiz: a truck rental rep (work, box truck on March 7) and a school parent (field trip bus on March 7). Same name and date, unrelated bookings, both already settled.
Hugo Brandvold asked for the same 30-hive quote from his farm address and his personal address; it is one request, already answered.
Colin Abara (Larkfield skipping the season) and Colin Marsh (syrup delivery delayed) share a first name only and both mention a delay; unrelated matters.
The township swarm removal list and Buzzline's campaign named Swarm share only the word swarm.
Brindle Cider's client tasting on March 20 allows a plus-one and Sunita wants a girls' night with drinks on March 20; joining a work client event to a personal outing is wrong.
Mill Creek and Tansy Hill both saw wrong portal invoice amounts, but Bea fixed the portal and sent corrected invoices.
Jar and label suppliers both raised prices, but an open to-do already covers reviewing both increases.
The mite treatment shortage only appears in two newsletters.
Rhoda and Lou both wanted a hive health talk on February 20, which is already past, and nothing followed.
Dario and Lina both want the cousins together sometime, with no date in either thread; a joint plan would invent dates.
